chunks: He felt afraid of them; but they said: "Have no fear," and gave him the good news of a wise son.

key_terms.أَوْجَسَ: He felt a sudden fear or awe

ai.seo_question: Who gave Ibrahim the good news of a wise son?
ai.summary: In this verse from Surah Adh-Dhariyat, the angels reassure Ibrahim (AS) after he initially felt a subtle fear (khifan) upon their arrival, promising him a learned son. While the glad tidings primarily refer to Ishaq (AS), Shia and Sunni exegetes often note the dual fulfillment in both Ishaq and his son Yaqub (AS), highlighting the continuity of prophetic wisdom. The term 'Alim' (knowledgeable) underscores the divine bestowal of deep understanding and prophetic insight upon this lineage.
